# Platform icons

The Xiaohongshu, CSDN and Baidu SVG paths in `assets/icons/platforms/` are from
[Simple Icons](https://github.com/simple-icons/simple-icons), retrieved on
2026-10-25. Simple Icons distributes its icons under
[CC0 1.0](https://github.com/simple-icons/simple-icons/blob/develop/LICENSE.md).
The SVGs retain their original paths; `fill="currentColor"` is added for styling.
The Baidu mark identifies its Baijiahao platform.

WeChat, Zhihu, Bilibili and the musical-note mark reuse the existing
PaperMod `svg.html` partial, under the theme's existing license and notices.

Brand names and marks belong to their respective owners. Their appearance here
identifies the author's publishing accounts and repository, without implying
endorsement. These assets are separate from scientific figure permissions.
